item.title: SASSA Older Persons Grant 2026: R2,400 Amount, May Payment Date & eLife Alert
item.description: The SASSA Older Persons Grant is now R2,400 per month (R2,420 if you are 75 or older) after the April 2026 increase. May 2026 payment starts 5 May. eLife certification is now required — here is everything you need to know.
